name: overruling_legal_bench
description: A legal-domain benchmark that evaluates model ability to recognize when a court decision overrules or affects prior precedent and to classify legal relationships between cases. Tasks typically require domain-specific reasoning over legal text, citations, and case outcomes. It is intended to test specialized legal understanding rather than general language ability.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark within MTEB used by researchers assessing legal-domain NLP systems, with limited mainstream adoption.
